MASTER_CELL_LIBRARY_PLANT.short_description: A labeled scientific illustration of a plant cell with a cell wall, membrane, large central vacuole, nucleus, chloroplasts, mitochondria, endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, ribosomes, and plasmodesmata.
MASTER_CELL_LIBRARY_PLANT.instructional_alt_text: Plant cell shown as a box-like cell with a thick cell wall and a large central vacuole. The nucleus sits toward the upper right. Green chloroplasts and orange mitochondria are distributed through the cytoplasm.

MASTER_CELL_LIBRARY_ANIMAL.short_description: A labeled scientific illustration of an animal cell with a cell membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus, endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, mitochondria, lysosomes, small vacuoles, centrioles, ribosomes, and cytoskeleton.
MASTER_CELL_LIBRARY_ANIMAL.instructional_alt_text: Animal cell shown as a rounded cell bounded by a flexible membrane. The nucleus sits above center, with endoplasmic reticulum around it, Golgi apparatus below and to the right, and mitochondria and small vesicles throughout the cytoplasm.
